note: SfM agreement is agreement with photogrammetry, not accuracy. Parity is parity, not accuracy.

sfm_agreement_odm_bellus.measurement: agreement with SfM sparse depth (scale+shift fitted in inverse depth on a random half of each image's points, evaluated on the other half)

sfm_agreement_odm_sheffield_cross.measurement: agreement with SfM sparse depth (scale+shift fitted in inverse depth on a random half of each image's points, evaluated on the other half)

parity_int8_vs_fp32_b1_wide.measurement: PARITY (int8 vs fp32 ONNX, raw network-resolution maps), not accuracy
